_fixture: Synthetic example for UI development; not real data. Tables only, so t and indicators are empty.

algorithm.description: Autocorrelation of the imbalance price and its cross-correlation with residual demand and the wind forecast, by lag.

tables.acf_price: Price autocorrelation at lags 1..K with a Bartlett band
tables.pacf_price: Price partial autocorrelation at lags 1..K with a +/- z/sqrt(n) band
tables.ccf_residual_demand: corr(price[t+k], residual_demand[t]) at lags -K..K; k > 0 means demand leads
tables.ccf_wind: corr(price[t+k], wind_forecast[t]) at lags -K..K; k > 0 means wind leads

algorithm.limitations: Retrospective association over the whole range, not causation. The cross-correlation band assumes white noise, so it overstates significance between autocorrelated series.
